verdict.rationale: Unity's own docs describe a built-in asset import process that converts source files and an Asset Database that keeps source and imported assets in sync, so incoming assets are processed without manual steps. The pack never mentions import hooks, import presets, or import-specific pipeline scripting. The command-line automation and public scripting APIs it does cite are generic building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented import hooks (post-processor callbacks), import presets, scripted batch reimport, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a technical artist, asset import is automatable — import hooks, presets, and pipeline scripts process incoming assets without hand-clicking each one

citations.quote: The asset import process converts most asset types from their original format to one optimized for use at authoring time and runtime.
The Asset Database stores information about the original source asset files and their imported counterparts to keep the two sets of data in sync.
